 C.S.DIAS,J.
 ====================
 B.A No.133 of 2024  ------------------------------------ --
 Dated this the 17th day of January, 2024
ORDER The application is filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, for an order of pre-arrest bail.

2. The petitioners are the accused 2, 5 and 6 in crime No.456/2023 of Kanjikuzhy Police Station,
Idukki District, registered against the accused alleging them to have committed the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420, 465, 468, 471 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3.Heard; Sri.Sojan Micheal, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioners and Smt. Seetha S, the learned Public Prosecutor.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that the first petitioner who is the second accused in the crime was arrested and interrogated, and he was released on bail by the jurisdictional Magistrate.
The petitioners 2 and 3/ accused 5 and 6 who are the brokers in the above transaction.
The custodial interrogation of the said petitioners is not necessary.

5. After bestowing my anxious consideration to the materials placed on record, and particularly taking note of the fact that the first petitioner/second accused was interrogated by the Investigating Officer and was released on bail by the jurisdictional Magistrate , I am of the view that the petitioners 2 and 3/ accused 5 and 6 are entitled for an interim order, which would do complete justice to both sides.
In the result, the petitioners 2 and 3/ accused 5 and 6 are directed to surrender before the Investigating Officer within one week from today, for subjecting themselves for interrogation.

After interrogation, and in the event of petitioners arrest, they shall be released on bail on executing a bond for Rs.50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousand only) each with two solvent sureties each for the like sum to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer.
The order shall remain in force for a period of three weeks.

SD/-
